changeSet.author: str-backend

column.name: is_legal_entity_owner
column.remarks: True if the accommodation owner is a legal entity (applicant is its authorised person)

column.name: legal_entity_country_id
column.remarks: Logical reference to str.country(id) — no DB-level FK because str.* is owned externally (read-only). Country of the legal entity's seat. Same source as country_of_residence_id.

column.name: legal_entity_city
column.remarks: City of the legal entity's seat (free text, not a code list)

column.name: legal_entity_registration_number
column.remarks: Registration/identification number of the legal entity (foreign equivalent of MBS)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE str_rn.lessor ADD CONSTRAINT chk_lessor_legal_entity_owner CHECK ( is_legal_entity_owner = FALSE OR ( legal_entity_name IS NOT NULL AND legal_entity_country_id IS NOT NULL AND legal_entity_city IS NOT NULL AND legal_entity_registration_number IS NOT NULL ) )

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE str_rn.lessor DROP CONSTRAINT chk_lessor_legal_entity_owner
